histories.MatterHistoryActionText: The resolution was approved by the Budget and Finance Committee and the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee. Council Member Spain moved to suspend the rules of procedure to introduce a late resolution. Without objection, Council Member Spain moved that the resolution be adopted, which motion was seconded and approved by the following vote:

matter.MatterTitle: A resolution approving a term extension and project scope change to a State Water Infrastructure Program Grant and accepting additional funds from the State of Tennessee, Department of Environment and Conservation, to The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, acting by and through the Metropolitan Department of Water and Sewerage Services, to modernize and upgrade the Dry Creek Water Reclamation Facility.

..title
A resolution approving a term extension and project scope change to a State Water Infrastructure Program Grant and accepting additional funds from the State of Tennessee, Department of Environment and Conservation, to The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, acting by and through the Metropolitan Department of Water and Sewerage Services, to modernize and upgrade the Dry Creek Water Reclamation Facility.
..body
WHEREAS, the Metropolitan Government, acting by and through the Metropolitan Department of Water and Sewerage Services (“Metro”), previously entered into a State Water Infrastructure Program Grant agreement with State of Tennessee, Department of Environment and Conservation, approved by RS2023-2118 and amended by RS2025-1023; and, 
WHEREAS, the State has notified Metro that they have leftover funding that is a risk of being returned to the Federal government on State projects where the funds were not utilized; and,
WHEREAS, Metro submitted an amendment request to the State, asking for a scope change and to extend the grant agreement term and to accept additional, available funds, in a total grant amount not to exceed $115,000,000.00, as specified in the attached preliminarily approval letter dated September 3, 2026, (Exhibit 1) from the State of Tennessee, Department of Environment and Conservation; and,  
WHEREAS, it is in the best interest of the citizens of The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County that this grant contract change be accepted.
 NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE COUNCIL OF THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY:
Section 1.	That the term and project scope of the State Water Infrastructure Program Grant, between the State of Tennessee, Department of Environment and Conservation and The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, acting by and through the Metropolitan Department of Water and Sewerage Services, is hereby extended through November 2026, as shown on Exhibit 1, a copy of which is attached hereto and incorporated herein, and the Metropolitan Government is hereby authorized to accept additional grant funding from the State, in a total grant contract amount not to exceed $115,000,000.00.
Section 2.	That the Director of the Department of Water and Sewerage Services, or his designee, is hereby authorized to execute such documents necessary to accept the grant as contemplated herein.
Section 3. 	That this resolution shall take effect from and after its final passage, the welfare of The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County requiring it.
